attrs.Gimmick: Drop between levels: putt into a sinkhole in the upper deck and fall 3.6 studs into a funnel bowl

attrs.Notes: Crystal-lined sinkhole rim flush with the deck (rock-candy crystals inside the shaft glowing pink), a low rope railing on posts outside the deck rails
Sandstone deck slab over the bowl's south end (the bowl runs 12 studs back under it, lit by the crystals); deck underside 3.2 above the bowl felt
